Curated parallels recorded on SuttaCentral identify close verse correspondences in the Pali *Udāna* (Ud 7.4, the *Dutiyasatta Sutta*) and across various recensions of the *Udānavarga* / *Dharmapada* literature, including the Sanskrit *Udānavarga* (UV 3, UVS 3, *Tṛṣṇavarga*), and Chinese translations in the Taishō canon (T 210.32 and T 212.3) [SuttaCentral]. Resembling parallels are also identified in *Dhammapada* verse 334, the Tibetan *Udānavarga* (Uv Kg 3), and T 213.3 [SuttaCentral]. Additionally, the verses are referenced in early post-canonical treatises, specifically the *Peṭakopadesa* (Pe 2) and the *Nettippakaraṇa* (Ne 9, Ne 37) [SuttaCentral].
